title: 第十二章 念头通达
content_zh: 众人顿时提起精神，专心倾听。“第一件事，苏家的势力，变卖成财力收归镇守大殿两成，让四家瓜分八成势力，但设定考核，到期不合格，剥离收回。”“第二件事，将财产筛选后，交给方彻。顺应这一次一心教的图谋，看看他们到底有什么打算，然后争取从方彻身上，摸到什么线索。”“第三件事，给各地天才秘密任务，无论如何，要全力阻击方彻，决不允许他得到第一，免得武院的同袍们为难。”“第四件事，全力查找一心教这几个人的下落。除了方彻的师父之外，另外的几人，一经找到，杀无赦！”下面立即有人问道：“为什么方彻的这个师父反而要排除？”“猪！这师徒俩，动一个就吓死了另一个，还怎么钓鱼？他俩是在明面上的，还用拔掉嘛？！”陈入海不客气的骂道。所有人都是立即明白过来。忍不住心中佩服。别看陈殿主面目粗豪，不拘小节，脚臭的像茅房，但是人家，是真的有本事啊。就这思维清晰的，让人震惊啊。对面，主持会议的中年汉子一脸愁苦，活像是欠了人家生生世世都还不完的债。他挥挥手，用一种哀莫大于心死的声音，低沉道：“殿主已经吩咐了，就这么做吧，大家都散了吧。”他一说话，顿时，陈入海立即将脚拿了下来，一脸便秘的穿上了靴子，翻着白眼道：“范天条，你能不用这种死了没埋的口气说话么？”“习惯了，我也不想的。”范天条忧愁的叹息，脸上的皱纹更深了。两人一开始说话，其他人顿时刷的一声都溜了出去。主要是这两人在一起说话的时候，那种感觉，让人感觉自己同时处在两个天地，那种割裂感，简直是让人发疯。偏偏这俩人一個是殿主，一个是副殿主。而且从不同地方调过来，凑在了一起。就成了这种格格不入的搭档。相看两相厌！彼此不顺眼。“你不走，有话要说？”陈入海翻着白眼。“那个方彻，身边必须要有人。我会向暗殿申请派人潜伏！”范天条一字字的道。听着这种嗓子破碎的愁苦声音，看着这张似乎是刚出生时候的皱纹终生都没有舒展开的脸。陈入海莫名的感觉难受，一挥手，偏着脸道：“那你自己安排。”“我安排，可以。”范天条嘶嘶的道：“若是万一有什么发现，会立即处死他，到时候你什么钓鱼计划，也完蛋了。”“完蛋就完蛋，你做主。”陈入海嗖的一声离开了。背后传来范天条冷冷嘶哑如嗓子完全坏掉哽咽的话：“以后开会你再脱鞋，我找你聊一夜！”砰！陈入海消失了。回到书房立即打报告：“被调到这里我认了，但我请求立刻调走范天条！”范天条在大殿中皱眉又考虑半晌，才终于皱着眉，一步一步蹒跚的走了出去。然后一条消息发往暗殿。“这边有个轻松任务，可以酌情派那些重点培养的天才来此执行，权做练兵。”……方彻接到镇守大殿同意自己‘代为保管’的消息，并不出意外的默默点点头。这么大动静，如此诡异的展开，若是镇守大殿还不知道自己和一心教有关系，从而对自己加强戒备，并且采取措施的话，除非那些人都是猪脑子。因为自己身上，明摆着一条线。“如果他们还能有脑子在我身边安插一个人手的话，就更妙了。”方彻心里默默的想。因为自己现在的实力，是无法有任何轻举妄动的。太弱，完全没有遮人耳目的实力。一旦被发现，必将夭折。自从选择了这么做，方彻就没有将生死放在心上，但是现在就死去的话，那也太可惜了。倒是孙元有些忧心忡忡起来。“彻儿，这件事儿……容易惹火烧身，如今看来，镇守大殿这么痛快的同意，分明是盯上了你。有些失策啊。”方彻坚决道：“被人盯上又如何？这兄弟义气，总不能不顾，苏越大哥的财产，我无论如何都要帮他保管好的。”“哎……也不知道你是真傻还是假傻。”孙元无力的叹口气。“不过这件事之后，你要做好准备，开始教义洗礼了。”方彻点头。这件事，全在他的预料之中。自从自己跳出来，不管是一心教，还是镇守大殿的人，只要不傻，都会有一番头脑风暴。而他们的所猜所想，方彻都能推算的差不多。所以他有绝对把握，事情绝对会按照自己的理想形势进行下去。最大的坏处就是……自己的身份在某些人眼中，等于是‘半暴露’。
content_en: Everyone immediately picked up their spirits and listened attentively."The first thing is to sell the power of the Su family and take back 20% of the guarding hall. Let the four families divide 80% of the power. However, if they fail to pass the assessment at the end of the period, they will be stripped and taken back." "The second thing is to screen the property and hand it over to Fang Che. Follow the plot of the Yixin Cult this time to see what their plans are, and then try to get any clues from Fang Che." "The third thing is to give secret missions to geniuses from all over the place. No matter what, we must do our best to stop Fang Che and never do anything.Allow him to get the first place, so that his colleagues in the martial arts academy will not be embarrassed."The fourth thing is to search for the whereabouts of these people from the Yixin Sect. Once they are found, there will be no mercy for the other people!"He asked: "Why did Fang Che's master want to exclude him instead?" "Pig! How can the master and the apprentice fish if one of them scares the other to death if he touches one? They are in the open, why should they be removed?!" Chen Ruhai scolded rudely.Everyone understood immediately.I couldn't help but admire him in my heart.Even though Palace Master Chen has a rough appearance, is informal, and has feet that smell like a latrine, he is really capable.It's shocking how clear his thinking is.Opposite me, the middle-aged man presiding over the meeting looked sad, as if he owed someone a debt that he would never repay in his lifetime.He waved his hand and said in a low voice with a voice that sounded more sad than heartbroken: "The palace master has given orders, so let's do this. Everyone should disperse." As soon as he spoke, Chen Ruhai immediately took off his feet, put on his boots with a constipated look, rolled his eyes and said, "Fan Tiantiao, can you not speak in such a tone of death?" "I'm used to it, and I don't want to." Fan Tiantiao sighed sadly, and the wrinkles on his face deepened.As soon as the two started talking, the others immediately slipped out with a swipe.The main reason is that when these two people talk together, the feeling makes people feel that they are in two worlds at the same time. The sense of separation is simply crazy.It just so happened that one of these two people was the palace master and the other was the deputy palace master.And they were transferred from different places and put together.They became this incompatible partner.We hate each other!They dislike each other."If you don't want to leave, do you have something to say?" Chen Ruhai rolled his eyes."That Fang Che, there must be someone by his side. I will apply to the Dark Palace to send someone to lurk!" Fan Tiantiao said word for word.Listening to this sad voice with a broken throat, looking at this face that seems to have wrinkles from birth that have not relaxed throughout life.Chen Ruhai felt inexplicably uncomfortable. He waved his hand and tilted his face and said, "Then you can make your own arrangements." "I can arrange it." Fan Tiantiao hissed, "If anything is discovered, he will be executed immediately. Then all your fishing plans will be over." "It's over when it's over. You make the decision." Chen Ruhai left with a whoosh.From behind came Fan Tiantiao's cold and hoarse words, as if his voice was completely broken and choked with sobs: "You can take off your shoes when we have meetings from now on, and I will chat with you all night!" Bang!Chen Ruhai disappeared.When he returned to the study, he immediately made a report: "I accept being transferred here, but I request that Fan Tiantiao be transferred immediately!" Fan Tiantiao frowned in the hall and thought for a while, then finally frowned and staggered out step by step.Then a message was sent to the Dark Palace."There is an easy task here. We can send those talents who have been specially trained here to carry out the task as appropriate. They can do military training."... Fang Che received the news that the guard hall agreed that he would "keep it for you", and he nodded silently without any surprise.With such a big movement and such a strange development, if the people guarding the main hall don't know that they are related to the Yixin Sect, so they strengthen their vigilance and take measures, unless those people are pig-minded.Because there is a clear line on him."It would be even better if they still have the brains to put someone beside me." Fang Che thought silently in his heart.Because of his current strength, he cannot act rashly.It's too weak and has no ability to cover up people's eyes.Once discovered, he will die young.Since he chose to do this, Fang Che has not cared about life and death, but it would be a pity to die now.However, Sun Yuan became a little worried."Che'er, this matter... can easily make you angry. Now it seems that the guarding the hall agreed so happily is clearly targeting you. It was a bit of a mistake." Fang Che said firmly: "So what if someone is targeting you? This brotherly loyalty cannot be ignored. I have to help him keep the property of Brother Su Yue no matter what." "Hey... I don't know if you are really stupid or pretending to be stupid." Sun Yuan sighed feebly."But after this incident, you have to be ready to start the baptism of doctrine." Fang Che nodded.This incident was all within his expectation.Since he jumped out, no matter whether it is the Yixin Cult or the people guarding the hall, as long as they are not stupid, they will have some brainstorming.Fang Che was able to calculate pretty much what they had guessed.Therefore, he is absolutely sure that things will definitely proceed according to his ideal situation.The biggest disadvantage is... that in the eyes of some people, my identity is tantamount to being 'semi-exposed'.
